text: Settings is now one short list: each setting shows its current value, and tapping it opens its own page
The Log buttons in your Library folders are easy to read in dark mode too
The Log Meal button on your meal templates is easy to read in dark mode
Everything you log through Claude is now one named meal: tap it to see each part. Claude suggests the name and uses today's date, so it asks you only once
Rename any meal in your day with the pencil next to it
Using Claude? In claude.ai, set every NutriScan tool to Always allow. Claude still shows you what it will save and waits for your yes, without the extra Allow pop-ups
Deleting your account now gives you 15 days: you can still look at and export everything, or tap Keep my account. After that everything is deleted for good
Export your data any time from Settings: Excel with four sheets, or a CSV zip (food log, goals, meal templates and your Library)
Claude can now read your Library and log foods from it. A new setting, Ask before saving new foods to my Library, decides whether it asks first
The scan error message is readable in dark mode
The Tracker now refreshes every time you open it, so food logged from another device shows up straight away
Show energy in kcal or kJ: pick it in Settings and the Tracker, Trends, Scan, Library and the AI assistant follow
Entries added by Claude show a small 'via Claude' tag in the Tracker
A HEIC photo your browser can't display now shows a placeholder and still scans, instead of a spinner that never ends
A slim bar tells you when you're offline
Trends highlights today by your own date, and the contact email in Settings is updated
Scan accepts iPhone HEIC photos, even in browsers that cannot open them
Calories you type are always taken as kcal: a big 950 kcal meal now shows 950 instead of being read as kilojoules
Editing a meal ingredient by weight keeps it inside its meal instead of splitting it out
The AI assistant sees today's log first thing in the morning, not yesterday's
Scan only accepts real JPEG, PNG or WebP photos now; anything else is refused with a clear message instead of a failed scan
Rapid-fire scanning is rate limited for a minute; the daily scan limit is unchanged
Deleting a folder, meal template or log entry now asks you to confirm first - no more accidental one-tap wipes
If something fails to save, delete or load in Library or Tracker, you now see a short message instead of nothing happening
Screen-reader support: every icon button is now named, and decorative icons are skipped
Logging a meal template now groups into one meal in your tracker (like 'Breakfast') that you can tap to expand and edit each ingredient
Set servings per item in a template - 2 slices of cheese, not 1 - and the totals follow through when you log it
Delete saved foods straight from library search results
Tap the NutriScan logo to jump back to the Scan screen
Tracker always shows the right day, and Trends uses your local date
Log Meal now confirms with 'Logged!' and the Tracker updates instantly
Pick multiple foods at once when building a meal template
Tab bar no longer floats mid-screen while typing
Fresh dark mode look — brighter accents, cleaner header
Header, banners and chat no longer blend together
Top bar stays visible in the AI chat tab
AI chat is now its own tab — no more floating window
Chat now opens as its own full screen
Pick your own time for each meal reminder — like 11:00 AM
Cleaner header — update alerts are now a banner
Settings: turn on meal reminders and weekly summaries, contact the developer, delete your account
Dark mode — toggle it from the top bar
Weekly summary notification on Sunday evenings
Pick which Google account to use when signing in
Email sign-in now uses a 6-digit code entered in the app
Daily meal reminders — turn them on in Settings
